hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Caribbean, island in the Caribbean Sea, south of Cuba || mostly mountains, with narrow, discontinuous coastal plain || third largest island in the Caribbean (after Cuba and Hispaniola); strategic location between Cayman Trench and Jamaica Channel, the main sea lanes for the Panama Canal || Resources: bauxite, alumina, gypsum, limestone || Exports: aluminum oxide, refined petroleum, natural gas, liquor, processed fruits and nuts (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly mountains, with narrow, discontinuous coastal plain || Caribbean, island in the Caribbean Sea, south of Cuba

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, humid; temperate interior || hurricanes (especially July to November)

economy.excerpt: upper-middle-income Caribbean island economy; key agriculture and tourism sectors; high crime, youth unemployment, and poverty; susceptible to natural disasters and global commodity price shocks; progress in reducing public debt and moderating inflation within target range || Exports: aluminum oxide, refined petroleum, natural gas, liquor, processed fruits and nuts (2023) || Industries: agriculture, mining, manufacture, construction, financial and insurance services, tourism, telecommunications
